从照片出发，设计一个属于它的边框: Create a frame inspired by your photo
描述想调整的地方，先看效果再应用: Describe your changes, then preview before applying
参考原照片和当前边框，调整后先预览: Refine the current frame using the photo as reference
保留照片与画布比例，设计只出现在留白区域: Your photo and canvas ratio stay intact; the design fills the border
可以留空，让 AI 根据照片设计；也可以写下元素、气氛或不想要的内容: Leave blank for a photo-inspired design, or describe motifs, a mood, and anything to avoid
无需先选风格。你的描述优先，未指定的部分交给 AI。: No style to select first. Your brief leads; AI decides the rest.
胶片、卡纸与图案，直接预览选用，无需 AI 生成: Film, mats and patterns. Preview and apply directly, with no AI generation.
深黑底片边、琥珀色细线与四角定位标记，干净利落。: A charcoal border with amber rules and precise corner registration marks.
暖白相纸、双层细边与底部短线，像一张整理好的暗房印相。: Warm photo paper, double rules and quiet footer lines, inspired by darkroom prints.
保留当前主题，优化图案形状、大小、位置与布局，让照片成为视觉中心: Keep the theme; refine motif shapes, scale, placement and layout around the photo
根据照片的内容、构图与色彩自主设计，保持清晰的视觉层次与适当留白: Develop an original design from the photo’s subject, composition and colors, with clear hierarchy and considered space
请在模型配置中连接账户并选择可用模型: Connect an account and choose an available model in model settings
